title: RLHF DECIPHERED: A CRITICAL ANALYSIS OF REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FROM HUMAN FEEDBACK FOR LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review of existing studies evaluating how the lack of diverse annotator demographics in RLHF leads to systematic political biases in language models.
Synthesis of prior research demonstrating that RLHF-trained language models disproportionately reflect views and values aligned with Western audiences.
